# Control Bento

> Interactive reference for the 93 Annex A controls of ISO/IEC 27001:2022.
> Search by control ID, title or description; filter by control type
> (Organizational A.5, People A.6, Physical A.7, Technological A.8).
> Each control opens implementation guidance: overview, core points,
> in-practice notes, evidence examples, plus ISMS.online and Hightable links.

## Scope

Covers Annex A controls only (A.5–A.8). Clauses 4–10 of ISO/IEC 27001:2022
are out of scope for this reference.

## Dataset

Machine-readable source: [controls.json](./controls.json) — all 93 controls
with title, type, overview, core points, in-practice guidance, evidence
examples, description, summary, and reference links.

## Author

Built by [Marcus Nightingale](https://mnightingale.dev) — senior PHP
developer (UK) and ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementor.
